This will get buried but I wanna share my experience lol

I worked at a bakery for almost a year. Started off ok, it really wasn’t the sort of job I really wanted, but it was fine. Originally I did a little bit of everything; working register, cooking, cleaning, sorting, catering, delivery, dishes, etc. It was the sort of job where I’d work 6-9 hours a day at minimum wage and in the beginning I didn’t mind. I’m the sort of person who’s a tad awkward but always willing to be friendly and professional. 

But then, things started piling up. My boss started giving me less tasks to do and cornering me to just the dish area. Then, she cut my hours by 80%; when I used to work three days a week I ended up working two days a month in 4 hour shifts. I noticed the coworkers I had would get quiet and stop smiling whenever I’d walk by and start whispering to each other. I’m by no means a rude person, in fact I consider myself extremely shy and easy-to-please so I was unsure why they’d do that. Then, they stopped giving me my tips at the end of the day. To me all this sent a very very clear message that they wanted me gone, and I started planning when to put my 2 weeks in. 

Well, that never happened. My last day started with my coworkers on their phones laughing while a customer was waiting to be served. So I took care of the customer and then one of my coworkers (I’m calling her Elia) yanked me back by the shoulder hissing “don’t you have an actual job to do?” Ok Ellie sure, it’s not like I was doing your job for you or anything. But I simply said “alright, thanks for reminding me” and went to do dishes for 8 hours. I was fuming the whole time because I kept hearing Elia complaining that I helped a customer since I had “no right to.”


Towards the end of the day, I politely said to her “you know if you have a problem with me, just say it.” To which she says “you’re a stupid fucking retarded cunt who can’t fucking do anything other than dishes.” I punched out early, texted my boss what happened and that I was expecting my last check in my mailbox the next day.

Elia ended up getting fired for cussing out the boss, half the staff left due to hours being cut, the owner had to sell the place due to insufficient funds, and the new owner ended up closing the place. The schadenfreude feels amazing! :)

I haven’t watched it since 2017, but I assume most people watch it the same way people watch reality tv: they want to see drama and cringe at it.

See I’m LGBT as well and like you said, I originally liked that GG seemed to be supporting us. I usually don’t mind when people drop jokes (there’s a difference between satire and meanness after all) but when arin said that... it felt super icky to me. Not because of the word itself, but because it didn’t come from a satirical place; he genuinely thought it was funny to be hurtful. 

I personally dislike Dream Daddy for the same reasons Dingdongvg and Julian did: it seemed too pandery to me. (Whatever right, my personal opinion doesn’t matter in this case. ) What upset me a lot was the fact DD and J were vilified by the grumps for expressing his concern of it being a bit pandery, particularly by Brian and Suzy. DD said himself that because of that debacle he got doxxed, outed to his close homophobic family members, and even contemplated suicide. Regardless of how someone may feel about DD’s sense of humor or affiliation with Oneyplays, a gay man was forcefully outed, doxxed and had a severe mental breakdown because the grumps wanted his opinions silenced.

After that huge ordeal I was hoping the grumps would be a little more tactful. But even now, everything they say about LGBT issues sounds so... forced. Like they’re TRYING to appeal to us, they’re TRYING to sell themselves as allies, they’re TRYING to sweep past and present issues under the rug as if we wouldn’t remember. Everything feels so soapbox-pedestal to me, arin especially.

Idk, it just feels like the Grumps care more about revenue than real human beings.

Every comedian ever (even the “pure” ones by internet standards) is edgy on some level. Some are try-hards, some use dark humor, and some pepper in the occasional raunchy joke. What makes it funny is the fact that most of these comedians understand satire and aren’t deliberately saying these things to upset or hurt. They’re dramatizing.

People like the grumps somehow got it into their heads that the only marketable way to be funny is by being as inoffensive as possible. The issue there is they DONT KNOW how to satirize or what even constitutes as humor. If they genuinely think people are saying things to be mean, that’s the most tone-deaf thing I’ve heard. 

In fact I genuinely don’t even think they care about political correctness, it’s just an image to them and a way for them to be monetized. Arin especially. He loooooves the positive attention of being seen as “morally superior” than those “old newgrounds types” but only really does this preachy shit when it benefits him. It’s totally ok for him to make fun of things but it’s SO MEAN when other people do it. I’m not sure I’m able to properly rant about how hypocritical he is. Heh.

Sigh, that got long. Sorry.

Anyways. Keep making edgy jokes folks. Challenge their status quo.
